list: Official 55 trophies: names, descriptions and grades as published by PlayStation. Guides are written for this atlas in our own words; each cites its source.
note: Hidden flags mark the story and secret trophies PlayStation hides until earned. Five trophies are honestly UNCONFIRMED: no verified method exists yet, so their guides say so instead of guessing.

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies first and this one unlocks on its own. Work the roadmap in order: story, then activities, then collectibles, then the 100% cleanup.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing through to its end. It is unmissable story: follow the opening beats and the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list; GTA Wiki — GTA VI missions

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1. Before you leave the chapter, stop at the balcony meditation spot for Positive Mental Attitude — it is the only missable trophy in the game.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list; GTA Wiki — GTA VI missions

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2. Chapter trophies are unmissable: keep to the main path and each one pops at its chapter-complete screen.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list; GTA Wiki — GTA VI missions

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3. No side content is needed for this one — the main path alone carries it.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list; GTA Wiki — GTA VI missions

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4. By now the open-world feats (stunts, races, ranges) are all unlocked, so they make a good breather between story beats.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list; GTA Wiki — GTA VI missions

trophies.guide: Play the final mission to its end. It is the story gold: finish the campaign and it pops with the credits. Save before it if you want to keep a free-roam save for cleanup.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list; GTA Wiki — GTA VI missions

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Mission trophies pop at the mission-complete screen, so a clean run with no restart still counts.
trophies.name: Trust
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list; GTA Wiki — GTA VI missions

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions are long, so stock up on armour and ammo before you start rather than mid-mission.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list; GTA Wiki — GTA VI missions

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Like the other mission trophies it is unmissable story — it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list; GTA Wiki — GTA VI missions

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Keep a manual save from just before the mission in case you want to replay it for fun later.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list; GTA Wiki — GTA VI missions

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. The airport setting makes this a good warm-up for the unscheduled-departure feat in Catch Me If You Can.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list; GTA Wiki — GTA VI missions

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Expect heavy combat: bring your best weapons and use cover instead of rushing the open ground.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list; GTA Wiki — GTA VI missions

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion in the in-game stats. It is the long gold: story, stranger strands, activities, collectibles and the rest all feed it, so treat this checklist as the road to it.
trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts across Leonida: jumps, near-misses, drifts and airtime all count. Chain them during normal driving and the count climbs without a dedicated grind.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA VI trophy roadmap

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once: racing, fishing, shooting range, drone races, arcade, bowling, stunts, challenges and stranger strands. One try each is enough — no wins needed.
trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Learn each range's rhythm first on lower medals, then chase gold with the weapon the challenge favours; patience beats rushing.
trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA VI trophy roadmap

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Learn each course's corners before racing flat out — a clean line wins more races than top speed.
trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races across Leonida's circuits. Variety counts, not repeats: a new track each time, and pick the vehicle class you drive best.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Challenge Cal to a fishing duel and out-fish him. Watch the line tension and reel in the pauses; a lost fish costs the challenge, so play it steady.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list; GTA Wiki — GTA VI activities

trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game all the way through. Pick the shortest cabinet first — completion, not a high score, is what the trophy asks for.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list; GTA Wiki — GTA VI activities

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Play Andy's mission strand to its final mission. Stranger strands unlock as you explore, so check the map for new stranger markers between story chapters.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list; GTA Wiki — GTA VI strangers

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Play Kenton's mission strand to its final mission. Strands are independent of the story, so you can finish them whenever they appear.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list; GTA Wiki — GTA VI strangers

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Play Billy's mission strand to its final mission. If a strand stalls, explore more of the map — the next mission usually unlocks with progress elsewhere.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list; GTA Wiki — GTA VI strangers

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 full stranger strands. Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone are five of them — find three more strangers across the state and play each strand to its end.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list; GTA Wiki — GTA VI strangers

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Play Randy's mission strand to its final mission. Randy's strand is one of the eight that count toward Strangers & Freaks, so it does double duty.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list; GTA Wiki — GTA VI strangers

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Play Tyrone's mission strand to its final mission. Like the other strand finales it is unmissable once the strand is available — just play it through.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list; GTA Wiki — GTA VI strangers

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. MISSABLE: one spot is a Chapter 1 balcony — meditate there before Chapter 1 ends or it is gone for this playthrough. The other 17 spots stay open in free roam, so sweep them after the story.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list; Chapter 1 balcony spot

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Track down the unique animal Bret asks for and hunt it. Bring a scoped rifle, move slowly, and take the shot only when you are sure — a spooked animal costs you the stalk.
trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list; GTA Wiki — GTA VI hunting

trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards hide across Leonida — shops, interiors and out-of-the-way corners. Trade duplicates if the game allows it, and tick sets off as you finish them.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI collectibles

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 different locations. Fold it into your travel: tag a spot every time you arrive somewhere new and the count builds on its own.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA VI trophy roadmap

trophies.guide: Finish any 50 challenges. Challenges span driving, combat and exploration, so pick the easy ones first and let the harder ones come with practice.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then break line of sight and stay hidden until it clears. Use the backstreets and waterways — the open highway keeps you spotted.
trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list; GTA Wiki — GTA VI wanted system

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner while keeping your wanted level the whole time. Plan a route of three close shops, hit them fast, and do not let the level drop between robberies.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list; GTA Wiki — GTA VI robberies

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Just drive what you see: new models register on sight, so vary your rides and explore car parks, docks and back roads.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list; GTA Wiki — GTA VI vehicles

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: In one Combat Focus, take down 5 enemies. Set it up: lure a group close together, trigger focus, and work through them fast before the meter runs out.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave Vice City International Airport in a way the schedule never planned. Steal a plane or helicopter on the tarmac and get airborne before security closes in.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list; GTA Wiki — GTA VI locations

trophies.guide: Deal with the Rhinos — the tanks. Bring heavy weapons or a fast escape plan, and never fight a tank on foot in the open.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store and leave without ever being spotted. Go quiet: no alarms, no witnesses, no cameras catching you — plan the entry and the exit before you move.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA VI trophy roadmap

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Vaults are the big jobs: scout the approach, bring your best gear, and have a getaway vehicle ready before you go in.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list; GTA Wiki — GTA VI robberies

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Stop an armored truck, take its cargo and escape. Ambush it on a quiet stretch of road where you control the getaway, not in the middle of the city.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list; GTA Wiki — GTA VI robberies

trophies.guide: Visit all 52 areas of Leonida. The in-game map tracks what you have seen — sweep the coastline, the swamps and the small towns last, since those are the ones players miss.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI collectibles

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs. Work gang by gang and keep a note of which crews you have hit — the ninth one is the one players forget.
trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list; GTA Wiki — GTA VI gangs

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no verified method exists yet. The description points to a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach: order a cocktail somewhere with an ocean view and see if it pops. Do not trust a method until a sourced community report confirms it.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (description only) — no verified community method yet

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no verified method exists yet. The description suggests driving out through a vehicle showroom's glass in classic style. Wait for a sourced report before attempting a specific showroom — this guide will not guess one.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (description only) — no verified community method yet

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley and follow through on your throw. One full game should do it — focus on a smooth release rather than power.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list; GTA Wiki — GTA VI activities

trophies.guide: Build a partnership that draws a crowd. This one tracks shared and partner play — team up, play together, and let the partnership's appeal grow over several sessions.
trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Make choices that count — the tracker behind this one runs to 500. Play naturally and make the big calls when they come; it accumulates across the whole game, not in one sitting.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no verified method exists yet. The description hints at succeeding on a second attempt at something. Until a sourced report names the activity, treat every retry as a candidate and this guide will update when the community confirms it.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (description only) — no verified community method yet

trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no verified method exists yet. The description reads like a rare random event. If something strange happens in free roam, note where and what — the community will pin this one down together.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (description only) — no verified community method yet

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no verified method exists yet. The description suggests knocking someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Wait for a sourced report on the exact setup before grinding this one.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (description only) — no verified community method yet

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Bills come from robberies and heists — keep a steady flow through your contacts and the total adds up across the game.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list; GTA Wiki — GTA VI economy

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Weapons, clothes, vehicles and upgrades all count — buy what you actually use and the total comes naturally by the late game.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list; GTA Wiki — GTA VI economy

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties. Save up and buy them as they appear on the market — they also store the vehicles you register for On the Spot.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI collectibles

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. Find a vehicle, open the app and register it — ten different rides and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list; GTA Wiki — GTA VI vehicles
